findings.message: The no-mutation test only partly covers the step's arguments. In packages/simulation/src/match/match.test.ts, Script deep-freezes the state and the input, but the MatchConfig it passes to stepMatch (PUBLIC/PRIVATE) is never frozen. property.test.ts does the same with the config from createMatchConfig. If stepMatch mutated its config argument, no test would catch it. The input parameter itself is covered, so this is minor: freezing the config in both harnesses would close the gap.
findings.requirement: It never mutates its input, and it is idempotent for repeated or stale inputs.
